name: Cuirass
text: A breastplate and backplate that guard the torso.

name: Gauntlets
text: Armoured gloves that guard the hands and wrists.

name: Greaves
text: Leg armour that guards from hip to ankle.

name: Left Pauldron
text: A shoulder guard for the left arm.

name: Right Pauldron
text: A shoulder guard for the right arm.

name: Helm
text: A helm that guards the skull and much of the face.

name: Boots
text: Armoured boots that guard the feet and shins.

name: Buckler
text: A small round shield held in the fist, quick to turn a blade.

name: Round Shield
text: A round shield of moderate size, the common soldier's companion.

name: Kite Shield
text: A tall tapering shield that covers a rider from shoulder to knee.

name: Tower Shield
text: A massive shield behind which a soldier can all but disappear.

name: Hauberk
text: A long protective coat that hangs to the knees.

name: Chausses
text: Leg coverings laced to the belt beneath the tunic.

name: Left Spaulder
text: Overlapping plates that protect the left shoulder and upper arm.

name: Right Spaulder
text: Overlapping plates that protect the right shoulder and upper arm.

name: Sollerets
text: Armoured shoes that guard the feet.

name: Jerkin
text: A close-fitting jacket worn as light armour.

name: Cuisse
text: A guard strapped over the thigh.

name: Helmet
text: A plain helmet that keeps the skull in one piece.

name: Boots
text: Sturdy boots reinforced for the road and the fight.

name: Gloves
text: Protective gloves, flexible enough for a firm grip.

name: Left Vambrace
text: A guard for the left forearm.

name: Right Vambrace
text: A guard for the right forearm.
